rationale: With only 24 minutes to close and price sitting at 88% of today's range after a 13.5% gap-up, the risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction. The last five 1-minute candles show extremely tight, low-volume consolidation with no directional momentum — price is essentially pinned near the 9-EMA with no clear breakout or breakdown signal. Entering long near the day's high with forced liquidation at close, or shorting into a strong gap-up trend with elevated relative volume, both carry asymmetric risk that does not justify deployment of capital.
